text:
Nina: Heads-up: I'm assembling a compact 'manager first-week kit' we can attach to offers. goal: reduce admin churn and give new managers a predictable first 7 days. thoughts?
Diego: Love it. Key ask: include a short who-to-contact table (IT, Security, Facilities, Legal). managers hate guessing.
Riley: Also include a bite-sized 30/60/90 template they can fork into their doc folder. Keep it outcome-oriented.
Ben: Security checklist: MFA, disk encryption check, KMS request if needed, and access to incident runbooks. Recommend making these prioritized (must/doable/optional).
Nina: Agreed. Draft outline below, trying to keep calendar invites to < 4 hours total scheduled. please add edits.
Nina: Pre-start (2-3 days before): submit Okta + infra access tickets, confirm laptop shipment, assign buddy, badge request if office.
BadgeBot: Badge request queued. ETA 2 business days.
Riley: Day 1 (half-day onboarding): 30m Manager welcome w/PeopleOps, 20m HR admin, 30m team meet & greet, 15m systems access runthrough (Okta, Console links).
Diego: Day 2: 45m Product context + roadmap, 30m Security intro (Ben), 30m Buddy shadow session.
Ben: Add a 15m quick runbook walkthrough: "how to escalate a security incident" + link to runbook.
Nina: Day 3: 45m 30/60/90 planning workshop (manager only), 30m 1:1 kickoff template with direct reports.
Riley: Day 4: ops primer (60m) : monitoring, SLAs, Redwood Console tour; Day 5: Stakeholder intros + end-of-week sync (30m).
Diego: Tiny calendar bundle (paste into invite):
```
- Day 1 09:30 - PeopleOps: Welcome & Admin (50m)
- Day 1 11:00 - Team intro / meet & greet (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 - Product + Roadmap (45m)
- Day 2 14:00 - Security intro (30m)
- Day 3 10:00 - 30/60/90 planning (45m)
- Day 4 09:30 - Infra & Monitoring primer (60m)
- Day 5 15:00 - Stakeholder intro + Week 1 recap (30m)
```
Nina: 30/60/90 skeleton (copyable):
- 30d: build relationships, clear access for team, deliver first small operational improvement.
- 60d: own a prioritized backlog item, introduce one process change, run first planning cadence.
- 90d: measure impact of process change, set draft OKRs, present progress to stakeholders.
Riley: Useful to include 3 example goals per team type (eng infra, product, platform). I'll draft and drop here.
Ben: Make sure to flag compliance-heavy hires: add "Schedule Legal & Security intake in week 1" line.
Nina: Agreed. Also proposing a 5-question end-of-week survey to capture blockers: access problems, docs missing, unclear owners, meeting overload, onboarding pace. short checkboxes.
Diego: Could we auto-trigger a ticket when survey reports 'access problems'? Or at least tag IT.
Riley: Please include a tiny 1:1 agenda snippet they can paste: "Quick wins / Roadblocks / Next priorities / Support needed" 15m.
Nina: Last bit: add note for hiring managers: create Okta + infra tickets 3 working days before start. this reduces laptop/VPN delays.
Diego: I'll build a Google Calendar template and add a one-page PDF cheat sheet for offers.
Nina: Perfect. I'll publish the kit to People Ops docs and link here: https://redwood.link/new-manager-kit (will post final link).
Riley: Thanks everyone. if you spot anything missing ping me. :raised_hands:
